flow.name: Check params
SQL Query
flow.script:
tw.local.sqlQueryStr
SELECT
  PERSON_INFO.ID_PERSON AS idPerson,
  PERSON_INFO.EXT_ID_EMPLOYEE AS employeeNumber,
  PERSON_INFO.MANAGER_NIF AS nifManager,
  PERSON_INFO.NAME_PERSON as name,
  PERSON_INFO.DISPLAY_NAME as displayName,
  PERSON_INFO.NIF_PERSON AS fiscalNumber,
  PERSON_INFO.EXT_ID_SOCIETY as societyNumber,
  PERSON_INFO.SOCIETY as society,
  PERSON_INFO.EXT_ID_COMPANY as companyNumber,  
  PERSON_INFO.ID_COMPANY as idCompany,
  PERSON_INFO.NIF_COMPANY as nifCompany,
  PERSON_INFO.COMPANY as company,  
  PERSON_INFO.PHONE_WORK_CENTER as phoneWorkCenter,
  PERSON_INFO.EXT_ID_DIVISION as extIdDivision,
  PERSON_INFO.EXT_ID_COST_CENTER as costCenterNumber,
  PERSON_INFO.COST_CENTER AS costCenter,
  PERSON_INFO.ID_COST_CENTER AS idCostCenter,
  PERSON_INFO.ACCOUNT_NAME as accountName,
  PERSON_INFO.EMAIL AS email,
  (CASE WHEN PERSON_INFO.HAS_PORTAL_ACCESS = 'S' THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END) AS hasPortalAccess,
  PERSON_INFO.DIVISION  as division,
  PERSON_INFO.ID_SOCIETY as idSociety,
  PERSON_INFO.CARD_NUMBER as cardNumber, 
  DATE(PERSON_INFO.DT_ACTIVITY_START) as dtActivityStart,
  value(USER_COMPANY_PROFILE.IS_TO_SEND_ALERT,'') AS isToSendAlert,
  value(CATEGORIES.CATEGORIE, '') as category,
  value(CATEGORIES.EXT_ID, '') as extIdCategory,
  value(CATEGORIES.ID, 0) as idCategory,
  PERSON_INFO.WORK_CENTER as workCenter,
  PERSON_INFO.ID_WORK_CENTER as idWorkCenter,
  PERSON_INFO.DT_ANTIQUE as dtAntique
FROM PERSON_INFO
	LEFT JOIN USER_COMPANY_PROFILE 
		 ON USER_COMPANY_PROFILE.ID_PERSON = PERSON_INFO.ID_PERSON AND USER_COMPANY_PROFILE.ID_PORTAL_APP = ?
	LEFT JOIN PERSONS_CATEGORY	
		ON PERSONS_CATEGORY.ID_PERSON = PERSON_INFO.ID_PERSON AND PERSONS_CATEGORY.DT_ACTIVITY_END IS NULL
	LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES
		ON  CATEGORIES.ID =PERSONS_CATEGORY.ID_CATEGORY	 
WHERE ( PERSON_INFO.DT_ACTIVITY_END IS NULL or date(PERSON_INFO.DT_ACTIVITY_END) >= date(current timestamp) )
AND (VARCHAR('',20) = ? OR PERSON_INFO.ACCOUNT_NAME = ?) 
AND (VARCHAR('',20) = ? OR PERSON_INFO.NIF_PERSON = ?) 
AND (VARCHAR('',20) = ? OR PERSON_INFO.ID_SOCIETY = ?) 
AND (VARCHAR('',20) = ? OR PERSON_INFO.EXT_ID_EMPLOYEE = ?) 
AND (VARCHAR('',20) = ? OR PERSON_INFO.ID_PERSON = ?) 
AND (VARCHAR('',20) = ? OR PERSON_INFO.CARD_NUMBER = ?) 
AND (VARCHAR('',20) = ? OR PERSON_INFO.EXT_ID_SOCIETY = ?) 
	 	  	  WITH UR

tw.local.query
SELECT
	PI.ID_PERSON, PI.NIF_PERSON, PI.NAME_PERSON, PI.MANAGER_NIF, PI.EMAIL, PI.EXT_ID_SOCIETY, 
	PI.EXT_ID_DIVISION, PI.EXT_ID_EMPLOYEE, PI.HAS_PORTAL_ACCESS, PI.ACCOUNT_NAME, PI.DISPLAY_NAME 
FROM PERSON_INFO PI
INNER JOIN USER_COMPANY_PROFILE UCP ON UCP.ID_PERSON = PI.ID_PERSON AND UCP.ID_PROFILE_PORTAL_APP = ?
WHERE (PI.DT_ACTIVITY_END IS NULL OR PI.DT_ACTIVITY_END >= CURRENT DATE)
ORDER BY COLLATION_KEY_BIT( PI.DISPLAY_NAME, 'UCA500R1_S1')
WITH UR
